question: Does updating the planning-facing encoder with ego intent and selective future-latent objectives improve planning beyond planning-only encoder adaptation?
decision: Run all12 conditions x3 paired seeds to update512, including four matched last6-depth controls added after the user questioned last2 sufficiency and before any cache/training result. No best-dev checkpoint selection or result-dependent tuning.
scope: Continued partial encoder fine-tuning from the full PF planning checkpoint, not full 330-hour Drive-JEPA pretraining. Frozen first22 (last2 arms) or first18 (last6 arms) blocks and fixed original planner; full training of final2 or final6 blocks and final norm. FiLM injects observed 8D status within trainable encoder. No selector or future residual at inference. Old final-feature cache is only teacher/reference; differentiable student tail uses freshly verified prefix features. Dev is not an independent test and may have been exposed during foundation training.
teacher: Frozen official planning encoder, inspired by fixed-teacher latent learning; no EMA and not a reproduction of SALT's pixel-trained teacher.
target_policy: Uniform32 or16 highest observed motion/planner-Jacobian regions plus16 uniform remaining regions. Planner sensitivity is a current-feature proxy, not future utility labels. Future camera frames are teacher-only. All four future tubelets supervised with validity masks; horizon adaptation is not claimed.
mask_policy: Masked auxiliary stream removes all4 native patches of32 spatial regions BEFORE the first frozen encoder block. Two deterministic views per window/strategy; IDs preserved through RoPE. Dense current stream always feeds planner; all comparisons use identical observed images and teacher targets. Current control has identical four queries and future validity mask but current targets.
analysis: Official PDM for all24 final checkpoints plus original on same192windows; scene-macro ADE, recording bootstrap95CI, paired seeds, observed command/speed strata with two cutoff sets. Shared fixed linear future probe and encoder-only command intervention with planner status held fixed. No counterfactual safety or causal scene understanding claim.
